collection.title: Nissan 300 ZX 1984 to 1990 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Nissan 300 ZX 1984 to 1990 model which requires a 19" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
